senses.gloss: m. (חוּךְ II) laughter, gladness, object of derision.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 16:27">Targ. Jud. XVI, 27</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 12:4">Targ. Job XII, 4</cite> <he>חיך</he> (ed. Lag. <cite ref="H00730"><he>חַיַיךְ</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Berakhot 9b:18">Ber. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>לא פסק ח׳ וכ׳</he> laughter did not vanish from his lips (he felt happy) &c.
<cite ref="Shevuot 34b:22">Shebu. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>מאי ח׳</he> what is the cause of the laughter?—
